scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n pkgs,api,web -c magenta,green,cyan "npm:dev:packages" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:packages: npm run dev --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false -w packages/dice -w packages/rules-core -w packages/rules-5e -w packages/shared
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/dice -w packages/rules-core -w packages/rules-5e --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
